recall_prompt: Say how you would find the maximum or minimum value — say what decides which one it is, and what formula gives the value.
insider_note: b is −1, and (−1)² = 1 — the wrong square is the one slip in this question. The question asks for the minimum VALUE, not the x where it occurs.

page_header: Section A — Very Short Answer Question

steps.label: Sign of a
steps.margin_note: First mark. Read off a = 1, b = −1, c = 7. a > 0 means the graph opens upward, so there is a lowest point and no highest — the expression has a MINIMUM. Say which one before computing.
steps.memory_tip: a = 1 > 0, so the graph opens upward: a minimum and no maximum. Say which one before computing.
lines: Comparing x² − x + 7 with ax² + bx + c:
a = 1 > 0, so the expression has a

recall.must_convey: That a, b, c are read off as 1, −1, 7, and that a > 0 means the expression has a minimum value, not a maximum.
accept: compare with a x squared plus b x plus c, a is one which is positive so it has a minimum
a is positive so the expression has a least value and no greatest value
only the sign of a matters, a equals one greater than zero means minimum
a positive kabatti minimum untundi, maximum undadu
a is one b is minus one c is seven and a positive gives a minimum

steps.why: For a quadratic, whether there is a maximum or a minimum depends only on the sign of a: positive a opens upward and has a lowest point; negative a opens downward and has a highest point. The question says 'maximum or minimum' because that decision is part of the answer.
common_mistakes: Skipping the sentence that says which of the two exists.
Deciding 'maximum' from the constant 7 being positive — only a matters.

steps.label: Value
steps.margin_note: Second mark. Minimum = (4ac − b²)/(4a) = (28 − 1)/4 = 27/4. Note (−1)² = 1 — the square of a negative number is positive. The minimum occurs at x = −b/2a = 1/2.
steps.memory_tip: (4ac − b²)/(4a) = (28 − 1)/4 = 27/4. Note (−1)² = +1, and the answer is the value, not the x.

recall.must_convey: That the minimum value is (4ac − b²)/(4a) = (28 − 1)/4 = 27/4.
accept: the minimum is four a c minus b squared over four a which is twenty eight minus one over four equals twenty seven by four
substitute into four a c minus b squared by four a to get twenty seven by four
twenty eight minus one over four is twenty seven by four
four a c minus b square by four a formula lo pettithe twenty seven by four
minimum value twenty seven by four
heard_as: four a c minus b squared

steps.why: Completing the square gives a(x + b/2a)² + (4ac − b²)/(4a); the squared term is never negative and is zero at x = −b/2a, so (4ac − b²)/(4a) is the least value when a > 0.
common_mistakes: Answering x = 1/2 (where the minimum occurs) instead of the minimum value.
